# M3-S7: Go importers of loGo/s option and non-nil signatures (R-U2, T-Sec6).
# Package a exports F, Box, G, H; a Go package in another workspace module
# sees plain pointers and rt.Option, builds under logos, and gets
# MustNonNil panics on direct, go, defer, and method calls with nil.
# Calls through func values stay unchecked; eject plus upstream go stays
# unchecked too.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/interopnil$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/interopnil$GOEXE
stdout '^F-nil H-none G-ok: gadget defer-ok: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*a\.User at q\.go:[0-9]+ method-ok: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*a\.User at q\.go:[0-9]+ func-value-ok$'
stdout '^direct-ok: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*a\.User at q\.go:[0-9]+$'
cd ..

# go statements evaluate MustNonNil immediately and crash with the call position.
cd w
logos build -o $WORK/bin/interopnil-go$GOEXE ./g/cmdgo
! exec $WORK/bin/interopnil-go$GOEXE
stderr 'logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*a\.User at main\.go:[0-9]+'
cd ..

# Eject a Go main over a loGo/s dep via replace; upstream go has no checks.
cd e/gapp
logos run .
stdout '^dep-ok$'
stdout '^eject-check: logos$'
logos eject -o bout
exists bout/main.go
exists bout/_logos_deps/example.com/lp@v1.2.3/p/p.go
cd bout
go build ./...
go run .
stdout '^dep-ok$'
stdout '^eject-check: no-logos$'
cd ..
cd ..
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/a/a.lgo --
package a

type User struct {
	Name string
}

type T struct {
	X int
}

func F() *User? {
	return nil
}

type Box struct {
	P *T?
}

func (b *Box) Set(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

func G(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

func H() []int? {
	return nil
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/q/q.go --
package q

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"example.com/l/a"
	"logos/rt"
)

var _ func() *a.User = a.F
var _ func(*a.User) string = a.G
var _ func() rt.Option[[]int] = a.H
var _ *a.T = a.Box{}.P

func Run() string {
	if a.F() != nil {
		return "F-non-nil"
	}
	h := a.H()
	if h.Present {
		return "H-present"
	}
	got := a.G(&a.User{Name: "gadget"})
	out := "F-nil H-none G-ok: " + got

	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				out += " defer-ok: " + fmt.Sprint(r)
			}
		}()
		defer a.G(nil)
	}()

	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				out += " method-ok: " + fmt.Sprint(r)
			}
		}()
		b := &a.Box{}
		_ = b.Set(nil)
	}()

	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				msg := fmt.Sprint(r)
				if strings.Contains(msg, "logos: nil from Go value") {
					out += " func-value-CHECKED"
				} else {
					out += " func-value-ok"
				}
			}
		}()
		f := a.G
		_ = f(nil)
		out += " func-value-no-panic"
	}()

	return out
}

func DirectMsg() string {
	var msg string
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
			}
		}()
		_ = a.G(nil)
	}()
	return msg
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/q"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(q.Run())
	fmt.Println("direct-ok: " + q.DirectMsg())
}

-- w/g/cmdgo/main.go --
package main

import (
	"time"

	"example.com/l/a"
)

func main() {
	go a.G(nil)
	time.Sleep(time.Second)
}

-- e/lp/go.mod --
module example.com/lp

go 1.27

-- e/lp/p/p.lgo --
package p

type User struct {
	Name string
}

func G(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

func Msg() string {
	return "dep-ok"
}

-- e/gapp/go.mod --
module example.com/gapp

go 1.27

require example.com/lp v1.2.3

replace example.com/lp v1.2.3 => ../lp

-- e/gapp/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"example.com/lp/p"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(p.Msg())
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				if strings.Contains(fmt.Sprint(r), "logos: nil from Go value") {
					fmt.Println("eject-check: logos")
				} else {
					fmt.Println("eject-check: no-logos")
				}
			}
		}()
		_ = p.G(nil)
		fmt.Println("eject-check: no-panic")
	}()
}
